# CPSC 436C recipes

> Recipes for CPSC 436C project teams (cloud data engineering, UBC). A recipe is a whole task a team can clone, run
> and change: a small main scenario that runs end to end on a laptop or in an AWS sandbox in ca-central-1, plus extensions that
> each add one capability. Every recipe runs offline first (`uv sync && uv run pytest -q`, no AWS account, no key)
> and names the course practice and source behind each decision.

## Get the repository

- Repository: https://github.com/cpsc436c-2026w1/recipes (short link: ilm.wiki/436c/recipes)
- Clone:
  1. Clone the repository: `git clone https://github.com/cpsc436c-2026w1/recipes`.
  2. Enter the recipe folder: `cd recipes/<recipe>`.
  3. Install dependencies: `uv sync`.
  4. Run the tests: `uv run pytest -q`.
- Each recipe's top-level README.md is the recipe, under fixed headings: What you build, Use it when, Main scenario,
  Decisions, Requirements, Run it, What you should see, Extensions, Cost and clean-up, Adapt it.
- `index.json` lists every recipe for tools (summary, shapes, extensions, practices, files, commands, cost of one
  run). `AGENTS.md` holds the rules for coding assistants.

## Recipes

- [project-skeleton](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cpsc436c-2026w1/recipes/main/project-skeleton/README.md): the first project slice (live updates stored, in the lake, one number on a page) in each of the three project shapes; [ext-backfill](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cpsc436c-2026w1/recipes/main/project-skeleton/ext-backfill/README.md): a history copied into the lake with one CTAS a month, counted per day against the source, a view beside the live table, and the same rows in DynamoDB by an import from S3.
- [dynamodb](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cpsc436c-2026w1/recipes/main/dynamodb/README.md): a DynamoDB store keyed by the app's reads, with conditional writes, transactions and an export to the lake for Athena; in `ext-vector-search/`, vector search over riders' messages in the same table, filtered by fare and zone during the search, with the bytes and price of each vector write and search; in `ext-nearby/`, location lookups by map cell (geohash): the drivers within 500 m of a point from 9 Queries by key, the nearest N static points from rings of cells, and a transaction that moves a driver's cell item.
- [lambda-dynamodb](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cpsc436c-2026w1/recipes/main/lambda-dynamodb/README.md): an HTTPS API (Lambda function URL) over that store, with a least-privilege role; ext-dashboard-page serves a page of counts by zone with each zone's freshness (lake variant: an hourly Athena job), ext-read-path measures p50/p95/p99 warm, cold, after idle and on a fresh copy, into DuckDB.
- [simulated-runs](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cpsc436c-2026w1/recipes/main/simulated-runs/README.md): seeded simulated rides events with injected faults (twice, late, never, changed), deliveries by hour of receipt and the events and faults under _truth/ (the answer computed from them), one replayer for Kinesis, SQS, a function URL, S3 slot files or a local handler, whole-run scenarios offline and on AWS, a daily check of the deployed system with an email and a backstop alarm, and the shared helpers (event models, lake bucket and workgroups, tags and ledger, run log) other recipes copy.
- [streaming-ingestion](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cpsc436c-2026w1/recipes/main/streaming-ingestion/README.md): Kinesis to Lambda to DynamoDB, each update stored once, with the lag measured; windowed aggregates, fan-out, a scheduled source poller (each slot file once, missing ones shown) and SQS queue ingestion (dead-letter queue and replay) as extensions.
- [concurrency-correctness](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cpsc436c-2026w1/recipes/main/concurrency-correctness/README.md): two clients race on one item, a conditional write accepts one, and a retried write applies once.
- [agent-agentcore](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cpsc436c-2026w1/recipes/main/agent-agentcore/README.md): a Strands agent whose hooks enforce the limits and the approval before a write; its tools behind AgentCore Gateway; hosted on AgentCore Runtime; with requirements, test scenarios and an Inspect eval; [ext-sdk-lambda](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cpsc436c-2026w1/recipes/main/agent-agentcore/ext-sdk-lambda/README.md): an agent built with Strands Agents or Pydantic AI on Lambda behind a function URL with AWS_IAM auth; one read-only DuckDB SQL tool; the answer's value, SQL and rows come from the tool log; caps on model and tool calls and one 25 s deadline on both SDKs; gateway refusals reported as did_not_answer; eval trip-questions (12 cases x 3 runs x 2 SDKs)
- [lake-layout-experiment](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cpsc436c-2026w1/recipes/main/lake-layout-experiment/README.md): a layout experiment that is valid on a small table: growth past the 10 MB minimum within a spend limit, every run kept, median (IQR) and cost per 1,000 queries from summary.sql, Athena against DuckDB.
- [cdc-to-lake](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cpsc436c-2026w1/recipes/main/cdc-to-lake/README.md): every DynamoDB change reaches an Iceberg table that Athena queries, with lag alarms, table maintenance and rollback as extensions; [ext-scheduled-merge](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cpsc436c-2026w1/recipes/main/cdc-to-lake/ext-scheduled-merge/README.md): hourly Athena MERGE INTO of raw JSON Lines into one row per trip, counts per day, week or month rebuilt for late, repeated or corrected events, run log, lease, quarantine; [ext-maintenance](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cpsc436c-2026w1/recipes/main/cdc-to-lake/ext-maintenance/README.md): nightly compaction by a rule (files a query reads per day), OPTIMIZE ... WHERE per Iceberg day, CTAS and partition switch for plain Parquet, late files kept, two alarms.
- [s3-event-etl](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cpsc436c-2026w1/recipes/main/s3-event-etl/README.md): an S3 event calls a check function per file; bad rows quarantined with reasons; good rows loaded once into Iceberg by a Glue job (2 workers, 10 min, 4 runs a day) or Athena MERGE.
- [zero-etl-search](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cpsc436c-2026w1/recipes/main/zero-etl-search/README.md): a search index in OpenSearch Serverless kept in step with a DynamoDB table by a Lambda function on its stream.
- [llm-gateway](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cpsc436c-2026w1/recipes/main/llm-gateway/README.md): a client for the course LLM gateway that handles budget and rate refusals, and in `ext-deploy/` a model gateway's own source and deploy. The course LLM gateway students use is deployed from the course's own version, which can differ from this recipe.
- [llm-probes](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cpsc436c-2026w1/recipes/main/llm-probes/README.md): a table of what an LLM endpoint supports, per model (tool calls, structured output, streaming, prompt cache, embeddings).
- [dashboard-chat](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cpsc436c-2026w1/recipes/main/dashboard-chat/README.md): plain-language questions over a team's table, answered by read-only SQL that app code checks, with a trace per question; also as a Shiny web page. [ext-guardrails-redteam](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cpsc436c-2026w1/recipes/main/dashboard-chat/ext-guardrails-redteam/README.md) adds injection through stored text: text other people wrote (comments, reviews, names) passed to a model as marked data through a fixed-SQL tool (`comments_tool.py`), the citation and number checks (`guards.py`), the red-team run with attacks in data rows (`redteam.py --cases all --runs 3`) and the eval comment-attacks (`evals/comment_attacks/cases.jsonl`). [ext-athena-engine](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cpsc436c-2026w1/recipes/main/dashboard-chat/ext-athena-engine/README.md): text-to-SQL on Athena with limits outside the model (workgroup cutoff, query counter, one deadline, daily cap), a reader role scoped to one workgroup, eval trip-counts.
- [hybrid-retrieval-eval](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cpsc436c-2026w1/recipes/main/hybrid-retrieval-eval/README.md): keyword and embedding search fused by rank, with a retrieval eval per query kind.
- [llm-state-dynamodb](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cpsc436c-2026w1/recipes/main/llm-state-dynamodb/README.md): chat history per signed-in user, an answer cache and traces for an LLM app, in DynamoDB.
- [limits-and-alarms](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cpsc436c-2026w1/recipes/main/limits-and-alarms/README.md): a budget, reserved concurrency and alarms on errors, latency and cost per request; an agent loop with a step cap and a deadline.
- [cost-and-teardown](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cpsc436c-2026w1/recipes/main/cost-and-teardown/README.md): tags and a ledger on every create, an inventory by four routes, run/30-day/year costs from measured units and the price sheet, and a teardown with proof.
- [mcp-server-minimal](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cpsc436c-2026w1/recipes/main/mcp-server-minimal/README.md): a small MCP server with a schema tool and a read-only query tool over your tables, and a write tool that needs a person's approval.
- [model-routing](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cpsc436c-2026w1/recipes/main/model-routing/README.md): a small model labels each request and app code picks the path; the large model gets only the hard ones, with an eval of accuracy and cost.
- [workflow-patterns](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cpsc436c-2026w1/recipes/main/workflow-patterns/README.md): prompt chain, parallel calls (sectioning, voting) and evaluator-optimizer (model or code check as evaluator), one short file each; app code decides every next step and a cap bounds the model calls.
- [prompt-optimization](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cpsc436c-2026w1/recipes/main/prompt-optimization/README.md): one LLM step's instructions tuned with GEPA, reported on test questions the optimizer never saw; its eval matrix ([ext-eval-matrix](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cpsc436c-2026w1/recipes/main/prompt-optimization/ext-eval-matrix/README.md)) reports outcomes per group, counts each case once, and compares two cells on the same cases with an exact McNemar test.

## Lecture demo repositories

- [l18-planning-agent](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cpsc436c-2026w1/l18-planning-agent/main/README.md): a planner over a data catalog, bounded agents and runbook-first triage. Clone: `git clone https://github.com/cpsc436c-2026w1/l18-planning-agent`.

## Rules a reuse must keep

- App code checks what a model returns before it acts on it: the SQL is parsed and allowed only as one read-only
  query over known tables, a router label the app does not know sends the request to the large model, and a
  write waits for a person's approval.
- Limits live outside the model: the key's budget and rate limit in the course LLM gateway, step and spend caps in
  app code, reserved concurrency, timeouts, budgets and alarms in the AWS account. A prompt cannot raise them.
- Secrets never go in code, commits or captured output. Read the course MCP token from `KB_MCP_TOKEN` (the older
  `COURSE_MCP_TOKEN` still works) and the gateway's address from `COURSE_GATEWAY_URL` (or `GATEWAY_URL`), both from
  the environment. Provider keys never reach students.
- Region `ca-central-1`; every resource name starts with `$PREFIX`; run the recipe's clean-up after every run in AWS.
- Offline first: `uv sync && uv run pytest -q` must pass without an AWS account. When a decision changes, change the
  README's Decisions row, its requirement and its behave scenario with it.
